create_logger_for_rl_agent: create a Logger instance with a log directory and SAC agent format for training metrics
log_training_metrics: log training metrics like actor loss and critic loss to CSV and console output
log_evaluation_metrics: log evaluation metrics like episode reward to CSV files with step tracking
dump_metrics_to_csv: dump accumulated training and evaluation meters to CSV and console at a given step
log_model_parameters: log model parameter weights and gradients as histograms at configurable step frequency
